field.name: flags
field.impl: const iotdata_field_flags_t *const v = vv; return bits_write(buf, bb, bp, v->flags, IOTDATA_FLAGS_BITS);
const iotdata_field_flags_t *const v = vv; bprintf(bp, " %s:%s 0x%02" PRIX8 "\n", label, _padd(label), v->flags);

field.name: bits32

const iotdata_field_bits32_t *const v = vv; bprintf(bp, " %s:%s 0x%08" PRIX32 "\n", label, _padd(label), v->bits32);
